subject: Post-signature implementation milestones, evaluation checklist and training cadence
message_1_subject: Post-signature implementation milestones, evaluation checklist and training cadence
message_1_body:
Hi Elena,

Congrats again on completing the agreement — excited to get BlueBridge Labs into production. Attached is an initial implementation workbook (BlueBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx) that embeds the post-signature plan we discussed: rollout phases, canary approach, migration windows, and a training cadence. Summary below — please review and call out anything missing.

High-level phases (proposed):
- Phase 0 (Prep, 2 weeks): environment provisioning (VPC peering), secrets/KMS, telemetry hooks, baseline perf tests.
- Phase 1 (Canary, 1 week): 5% traffic / 500 sessions/day target across three regions to validate latency and model quality.
- Phase 2 (Ramp, 1 week): graduated increase to 50% with automated KV-cache warmup and batching tuned.
- Phase 3 (Cutover): full traffic, fallbacks enabled, post-cutover monitor.

Training and ops ramp:
- Internal admin workshop: 1 half-day (we propose Aug 31).
- Customer user cohorts: three 2-hour sessions (we propose Sep 7–9).
- On-call runbook handoff and dry-run: Sep 9.

Evaluation and success criteria (initial):
- p99 inference latency < 250ms for the 95th percentile of calls during canary.
- Cost per 1k tokens within the committed band in the SOW.
- Quality: Core prompt test set pass rate >= 95% (see workbook for prompts).

Telemetry & rollback:
- We will enable dashboarding with token-level cost, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rates, and prompt set regression alerts.
- Rollback policy: automated fallback to smaller model variant + region routing if error rate > 3% for 10 minutes. Full rollback plan is in the workbook.

Proposed schedule (draft):
- Pilot/canary window: Sep 10–17
- Ramp & migration: Sep 18–30

Action items for BlueBridge: confirm the pilot window and provide a 1–2 person list for the canary cohort (we can accept emails or a CSV). Also let procurement/legal know we may need an SLA addendum for Dedicated capacity (I attached a template).

I attached the workbook to make it easy to mark dates and owners; Marissa will own the updates. If anything here is off, tell me and we’ll adjust before we circulate to legal.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
message_2_subject: Re: Post-signature implementation milestones, evaluation checklist and training cadence
message_2_body:
Diego — thanks, this looks comprehensive. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Canary cohort sizing: can you confirm how you arrived at 500 sessions/day? We need to validate that against our traffic profile (I've attached a small sample user list so you can propose selection logic).
2) Rollback: we want an explicit upper bound on time-to-rollback (target <= 15 minutes) and a list of exactly who auto-notifies on failures (on-call + BlueBridge ops).
3) Training: support team needs an additional 30–45 minute Q&A session after each cohort. Can you add that?
4) Evaluation: legal asked to see the SLA addendum; please send the latest PDF (we attached our version of an SLA template). Also please add a data retention window for logs/kv cache — we require 90 days by default.

If you can fold these into the workbook and send back, we'll aim to acknowledge the pilot dates by Aug 30.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Product, BlueBridge Labs

Diego — I updated the workbook per Elena's requests and added a new sheet for evaluation. High-level changes:

Marissa

- Internal admin workshop: Aug 31 (diego->marissa to send invite).
- Customer user cohorts + Q&A: Sep 7–9 (three cohorts + 30–45 min Q&A each).

- Evaluation: Core prompt set pass rate >= 95%; p99 latency < 250ms during canary; cost band checks as specified in SOW.
